A architecture diagram titled "SEARCH + AGENT INFERENCE RUN LOCALLY" illustrating the interaction between a cloud-based coding agent and a local search agent system.
 * Coding Agent (Left Box): Represents a frontier LLM in the cloud (such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode). A label underneath states "34% fewer API tokens on code-search questions."
 * Local System Container (Dashed Box): Encloses two main components:
   * ColGrep-Agent-2B (Middle Solid Blue Box): A 2B search agent using llama.cpp with a 2.5 GB GGUF model. It receives a "question" arrow from the Coding Agent and returns "locations + code" back to the Coding Agent.
   * ColGrep (Right Box): Provides semantic search over a local index. It communicates back and forth with ColGrep-Agent-2B via multiple horizontal arrows labeled "search, read, repeat."

Contributor mode
Muse Code subscriptions default to Contributor mode. In Contributor mode, you get more usage from your plan in exchange for letting Meta use your content to train future Meta models. Contributor mode is a setting in Muse Code, and you can turn it off at any time, at which point your future content is not used to train Meta models (unless you turn it back on in your settings).

Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full are each available in either mode on the plans that include them. For the models each plan includes, see
